title: Baked Feta Pasta
subtitle: Roasted feta and cherry tomato pasta
excerpt: A block of feta and a tray of cherry tomatoes roasted together until soft and jammy, then stirred through pasta. It is one of the simplest pasta dishes you can make.
sourceNotes: Based on the viral Finnish baked feta pasta dish that became a global home-cooking favourite.

content.text: Use a block of feta rather than crumbled. It melts into a creamy sauce when roasted and mashed with the tomatoes.
Tip the cherry tomatoes and unpeeled garlic cloves into a large roasting tin. Drizzle with olive oil and scatter over the chilli flakes.
Place the feta block in the middle of the tin. Drizzle with a little more oil.
Roast for 30 minutes until the tomatoes have burst and the feta is soft and golden at the edges.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in a large saucepan of well-salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve a mug of pasta water before draining.
Squeeze the garlic cloves from their skins into the tin. Mash the feta and tomatoes together with a fork.
Tip the drained pasta into the tin. Toss to coat, adding pasta water as needed to loosen.
Scatter the torn basil over and serve immediately.

items.symptom: Sauce is too thick and clumpy.
items.cause: Not enough pasta water added when tossing.
items.fix: Add pasta water a splash at a time until silky.

items.symptom: Feta has not softened after 30 minutes.
items.cause: Block was too cold straight from the fridge.
items.fix: Return to the oven for 10 more minutes.

items.symptom: Tomatoes are still whole and firm.
items.cause: Oven not hot enough or tin too crowded.
items.fix: Increase oven heat and spread tomatoes in a single layer.
